title: Operational Support
outcome: Authorized operations staff can find, understand and safely resolve MVP booking exceptions across booking, payment, documents and visa without bypassing the owning module's rules.
actor: Authorized Operator Operations Staff acting within an active operator membership and explicit support permissions.
modules: Operational Support owns the exception queue, cross-module support projection, assignment and support activity timeline.
Booking owns booking state and exposes only approved recovery commands and support projections.
Payments owns payment state, reconciliation evidence and approved retry or reconciliation commands.
Documents owns review state, correction requests and private-file access boundaries.
Visa owns visa case state and governed lifecycle transitions.
Operators owns membership, operator scope and support permissions.
acceptance: Authorized staff can search by booking reference and filter an exception-first queue without receiving unrestricted database-style access.
Every result is scoped to the operator membership of the current staff member; foreign operator resources return safe not-found responses.
The case view composes truthful projections from Booking, Payments, Documents and Visa while preserving each module's ownership.
Only explicitly approved support commands are available, and every command is validated by the owning module's current state and invariants.
No support action directly edits another module's tables or bypasses its state machine.
Stale versions and concurrent actions are rejected with recoverable feedback and no loss of audit history.
Every support action records operator, action, target module, reason, timestamp, outcome and correlation identifier without sensitive customer or document content.
The queue prioritizes actionable exceptions and exposes age, severity and owning module without leaking payment credentials, passport data, private document keys or visa references.
Loading, empty, permission-denied, not-found, stale, partial-projection, action-failed and resolved states are complete.
Operator surfaces preserve the approved NoorPath visual language and pass keyboard, focus, target-size, reflow, reduced-motion and WCAG checks.
Telemetry records safe queue latency, exception counts, command outcomes and projection failures using opaque identifiers only.
exclusions: Full CRM, ticketing, customer messaging or contact-centre platform.
Unrestricted SQL-like search, generic record editing or arbitrary status mutation.
New payment-provider, document-storage or visa-provider integrations.
Bulk mutation, automated consequential decisions or silent exception resolution.
Customer-facing support chat, email, SMS, WhatsApp or push notifications.
Family or Mahram booking rules unless separately registered and approved.
